mapper.select: SELECT e.id, e.project_id AS projectId, l.event_id AS eventId, e.station_id AS stationId, CONCAT(UPPER(e.resource_type), '-', LPAD(e.id, 6, '0')) AS evidenceCode, e.resource_type AS evidenceType, e.resource_type AS resourceType, e.resource_url AS resourceUrl, ev.event_code AS relatedEventCode, e.source_record_key AS sourceRecordKey, e.hash_value AS hashValue, e.metadata_json AS metadataJson, l.link_type AS linkType, CAST(l.confidence AS CHAR) AS confidence, COALESCE(e.captured_at, e.created_at) AS archivedAt, e.captured_at AS capturedAt, e.created_at AS createdAt, CASE WHEN e.resource_url IS NULL OR e.resource_url = '' THEN 'pending' ELSE 'archived' END AS status FROM em_evidence_resource e LEFT JOIN em_event_evidence_link l ON l.evidence_id = e.id LEFT JOIN em_monitoring_event ev ON ev.id = l.event_id WHERE (#{projectId} IS NULL OR e.project_id = #{projectId}) ORDER BY e.created_at DESC, e.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
